mechanism: Oxybutynin's anticholinergic effects may reduce gastrointestinal motility and delay alendronate absorption, while alendronate can cause GI irritation that may be masked or worsened by anticholinergic effects.
action: Separate administration by at least 30 minutes; monitor for GI adverse effects and ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antimuscarinic agents with less GI impact if feasible.
